## Availability warning

Older JCenter-era entries are retained as historical index evidence only. JCenter retirement means this file must not imply that every old binary is still retrievable from a canonical repository.

## Android payment relevance

SunmiOpenService is a device/customer service API line rather than the core PayLib payment stack. It is retained because system/device-service behavior can affect deployment, device management and compatibility of payment applications.
